name: search_references
description: Search the PromptMika knowledge base for reference files relevant to a coding topic. Returns matching file URIs to load.

query.description: Search query, e.g. 'sql injection' or 'design tokens'

name: load_reference
description: Load a knowledge file by URI: references://{path}, skill://SKILL.md, claude://CLAUDE.digest.md. Files over 2000 lines are returned in batches.

limit.description: Max lines to return (default: whole file if <=200, else 200)

name: list_references
description: List the full catalog of knowledge references available in the PromptMika knowledge base.

name: load_contract
description: Load a bundle of 2 related PromptMika knowledge files in one call. First-run contract read: the PromptMika skill definition + the condensed user policy digest. Load this BEFORE anything else in a new session. Files: skill://SKILL.md, claude://CLAUDE.digest.md. Files are served in full — only files longer than 2000 lines are paged.

file_offset.description: File index to start from (0-1, default 0). Use to skip already-loaded files.

name: web_curl
description: cURL-like HTTP request. Returns full response: status, headers, body, timing, redirects, cookies. Supports any method, custom headers, body. Useful for debugging APIs, checking response headers, inspecting redirect chains.

follow_redirects.description: Follow redirects (default true). Set false to see 3xx response.

name: web_fetch
description: Fetch any URL over HTTP(S): method, custom headers, request body, redirects. Extract modes: raw, text, markdown, links, json. SSRF-guarded, 1 MB cap.

max_bytes.description: Response size cap in bytes (default 262144, max 1048576)

name: web_search
description: Search the web: DuckDuckGo first (free), Serper/Google fallback (free 2500 queries), Bing last resort (free). Returns title, URL, snippet.

name: web_crawl
description: Crawl a site: breadth-first, depth-limited, same-domain by default, robots.txt respected, configurable delay. Returns title + content per page with timing.

delay_ms.description: Delay between requests in ms (default 300, max 5000)

name: browser_scrape
description: Scrape JS-rendered or Cloudflare-protected pages. Multi-strategy: Jina Reader (free) → Google Cache (free) → Direct fetch. Returns title + markdown + timing.

name: security_scan
description: Scan code for security vulnerabilities across 100+ languages. Returns categorized findings with severity, location, and fixes. Runs on provided code content — pass the file contents in `code` and its name in `filename` for language detection.

code.description: The source code content to scan

filename.description: File name used for language detection, e.g. 'app.ts' or 'main.py'

name: generate_scaffold
description: Generate a secure, production-ready project scaffold (files + build commands) for a language. Returns the full file map as JSON so you can create every file. Includes CI/CD and security scanning by default. TypeScript scaffolds are project-type aware: web/app = Express web app, api = JSON API, cli = arg-parser CLI, lib = exported module, game = canvas game, test = vitest-only, embedded = library.
